operations.command: . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password --full-disk-encryption-only > /tmp/e2e-luks.log 2>&1 && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && ! printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-changed || { cat /tmp/e2e-luks.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-survived-reboot || { cryptsetup luksDump "$root"; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-both.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-both.log && accepts newpass456 && test "$(printf %s newpass456 | crypt)" = "$(cat /etc/nixos/secrets/hashed_password.txt)" && printf converged-both || { cat /tmp/e2e-both.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && grep -F 'already uses the new password' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && printf idempotent || { cat /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log; exit 1; }
